cases.observation: One synchronous call includes result and failure ports
cases.source: Case sync-result. Triggered on onTaskStart, call createTask once. The synchronous result stays on that call as success and failure. Reply on onTaskResult. completeTask is a payload constant, not a catalog operation.
Case async-callback. Triggered on onTaskStart, call createTask. An independent callback correlates back to that call. Do not treat the callback as the synchronous result.

cases.observation: Two intentional calls have different stable IDs
cases.source: Case repeat-call. Triggered on onTaskStart. Call createTask twice on purpose. Keep two steps with different ids. Do not merge them. Each call has lowercase success and failure outcomes. The first call's success targets the second call. Failure of either call, and success of the second call, target one reply step.

cases.observation: Real versioned operations; Java supplies catalog properties
cases.source: Case om-bindings. Bind the existing createTask step to the runtime catalog operation. Java writes the catalog id, version, protocol, method, and path.
